review.tagline: PyTorch library of image models, pretrained weights and reference training scripts
review.summary: timm is a Python library of image model architectures (ConvNeXt, EfficientNet, EVA, DINOv3, Swin and many more), most with pretrained weights, plus layers, optimizers, LR schedulers, data loaders and augmentations. It includes train.py, validate.py, inference.py and a sweep.py for hyperparameter search, aimed at reproducing ImageNet results. Recent work covers multi-label training, Muon-family optimizers and NaFlexViT variable-resolution models.
review.audience: ML engineers training or fine-tuning image backbones in PyTorch
strengths: Very wide architecture coverage; every family has variants with pretrained weights
Reference train, validate, inference and sweep scripts with YAML config and resume support
Large optimizer and scheduler set, including Muon, LAMB, Kron and WSD
Active: release 1.0.30 on 2026-09-22, commits through October 2026
weaknesses: Some model variants ship without pretrained weights
Vision backbones only; no serving layer or UI
Frequent behaviour changes: RoPE precision fixes alter low-precision model outputs
Maintainer left Hugging Face; maintenance releases continue but project direction is less clear
needs: Models: PyTorch checkpoints, Hugging Face Hub weights, ONNX export
